title: Cargo Door Structure Surround Frame Dent Blend and Reinforcement
abstract: Repair of a dent in the cargo door surround frame caused by loading equipment contact, by blending followed by a local reinforcement, with the door rigging check that closes the repair.

sections.purpose: Repair of a dent in the cargo door surround frame caused by contact with loading equipment, by blending the dent followed by a local reinforcement, with a door rigging check as the acceptance step.
sections.damage_assessment: Dents in the surround frame are caused by loading equipment and are found during the cargo compartment inspection. The assessment must measure the dent depth and the affected length, and establish whether the frame has been deformed or only locally indented; a deformed frame changes the door aperture and is outside this scheme. The door must be rigged and checked before the repair, because a frame dent that has moved the aperture shows up as a latch alignment error and that must be recorded against the pre-repair condition. Any dent within the latch fitting land is outside the scheme, since a blend there removes material the latch load path depends on.
sections.repair_procedure: Open the cargo door fully and secure it. Measure and record the dent depth and length. Do the pre-repair door rigging check and record the latch alignment. Remove the protective treatment from the repair area. Blend the dent to remove all sharp radii and any surface cracking, keeping within the blend depth limit. Confirm by eddy current that no cracking remains. Measure the remaining thickness. Position the local reinforcement using the angle ASH985770-45 with the plate D5230113056247 as shown on repair drawing RD-52-30-11-006, and install the doubler D5230113947598 where the blend has taken the thickness below the stated value. Drill the fastener pattern and install fasteners AGS534950-40 wet, with collars AGS685858K9. Restore the protective treatment. Close the door and do the post-repair rigging check.
sections.inspection_requirements: Eddy current inspection of the blended area after blending and of the reinforcement fastener rows after installation. A post-repair door rigging check is required and the latch alignment must be within limits and comparable to the pre-repair record. A repeat visual inspection of the reinforcement is required at every cargo compartment inspection, and a repeat eddy current inspection every 8 000 flight cycles.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: Dents up to 2.5 mm deep over a length not exceeding 120 mm, not within the latch fitting land and not accompanied by frame deformation.

repair_drawings.title: Local reinforcement over blended surround frame dent

type_data.fastener_pattern: Two rows of fourteen, 22 mm pitch, 15 mm edge distance, clear of the latch fitting land
type_data.fatigue_life_note: Not life limited. Repeat eddy current inspection every 8 000 flight cycles and a visual inspection at every cargo compartment inspection.
